traits.zh: 提供拿铁、美式、澳白，特调用限定豆子与酒类搭配
traits.en: Serves lattes, americano, flat white; special blends with spirits

traits.zh: 拿铁美式价格仅15/18元，被称作‘良心价’
traits.en: Lattes and americanos at only 15/18 RMB, very affordable

traits.zh: 去年下半年才正式营业，已成延平路男女老少都青睐的精品咖啡店
traits.en: Opened late last year, now a local favorite on Yanping Road

traits.zh: 敞开式区域让人不由自主望向吧台，咖啡香气扑鼻
traits.en: Open area draws eyes to the bar, coffee aroma fills the air

traits.zh: 使用高价咖啡机和磨豆机等设备
traits.en: Uses high-end coffee machines and grinders

focus.zh: 站着喝的小店不适合专注工作
focus.en: Standing bar, not for deep work

linger.zh: 站着喝的小店适合即买即走

adventure.zh: 有特调饮品，但主要还是经典意式
adventure.en: Has special blends, but mainly classic espresso drinks
